timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,540 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is at a 28-year weak point (high KRW per USD), making dollars expensive to buy right now. However, news suggests downward pressure on the exchange rate ("환율 하락 압력") with stabilization expected around 1,540, indicating the won may strengthen soon—meaning waiting could lower your conversion cost.

TIP: If the won continues strengthening toward 1,500, delaying your conversion could save you money; if it weakens further past 1,540, convert immediately rather than wait longer.
